title: Imigomo Yesevisi
html:
Le webhusayithi ye-inthanethi https://kyber.stream ishicilelwa futhi iphethwe yi-KYBER SAS, inkampani yamasheya elula enemali eyisisekelo yamasheya engu-€132.00, ebhaliswe kuRejista Yezohwebo Nezinkampani yaseCréteil ngaphansi kwenombolo 909894768, ehhovisi layo elikhulu likuyi-24 rue René Thibert, 94800 Villejuif, futhi inombolo yayo yentela yenani elengeziwe yangaphakathi kweNyunyana YaseYurophu ingu-FR41909894768.

Ungaxhumana nathi nge-imeyili ku-contact@kyber.media .

Umqondisi wokushicilela nguJean-Baptiste Kempf.

Le sayithi isingathwa yi-Strapi, Inc (“Strapi”): inkampani yaseMelika ehhovisi layo elibhalisiwe likuyi-3500 S Dupont Hwy, Dover, DE 19901, USA, ebhaliswe ngaphansi kwenombolo 30-1201421, futhi emelwe nguMnu. Pierre Burgy, i-CEO yayo.

Impahla Yengqondo

AmaSevisi, uphawu lwenkampani, izixhumi-mbono, izithombe kanye namaWebhusayithi kungokwe-Kyber noma kwabaphathi bamalayisensi bayo, futhi kuvikelwe ngumthetho osebenzayo, onke amalungelo agodliwe. I-Kyber ikuthatha ngokungathi sína kakhulu ukuvikelwa kwamalungelo empahla yengqondo, kuhlanganise namalungelo obunikazi bemibhalo nemisebenzi.

Ngaphandle uma kunenkomba ecacile ephikisayo kule Migomo, ayikho ingxenye yamaSevisi ethu, yamaWebhusayithi, noma yanoma yikuphi okuqukethwe okungokwengqondo engakopishwa, ikhiqizwe kabusha, ishicilelwe kabusha, ilayishwe, ishicilelwe, iboniswe obala, ifakwe ngekhodi, ihunyushwe, idluliswe, noma isakazwe nganoma iyiphi indlela (kuhlanganise nangokwenza “isibuko”) kwenye ikhompyutha, iseva, iwebhusayithi noma kwenye indlela yokushicilela noma yokusakaza, noma ngenhloso yanoma yiliphi ibhizinisi lokuhweba, ngaphandle kwemvume ebhaliwe etholwe ku-Kyber kusengaphambili.

Izingxabano

Uma unemibuzo noma izikhalazo, sicela uxhumane nathi nge-imeyili ku-contact@kyber.media, ukuze sizame ukuthola isixazululo.
